Subject: Sizing session to quantify production load & schedule dedicated capacity call

Hi Elena —

Thanks again for the great discovery call earlier today. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we can get a focused dedicated-capacity sizing session on the calendar: 

Key takeaways from our call:
- Primary use case: real-time document summarization inside Finova customer portal (inference on user inputs + doc context).
- Target latency: p95 under 200ms for responses triggered from UI, P99 target discussed as 300–400ms (we should clarify strictness).
- Expected concurrency: you estimated 150–300 concurrent users at launch, with bursts up to ~800 concurrent during morning batch windows.
- Typical prompt payload: 300–800 tokens (avg ~470), responses ~150–300 tokens.
- Security: prefer Private deployment behind VPC, need KMS integration and audit logs — we flagged Private as likely.

Outstanding items for sizing call (helpful if you can confirm before we meet):
1) A short sample of request size distribution (CSV or small trace: timestamps, input_tokens, output_tokens).
2) Expected sustained RPS vs peak bursts (and burst duration).
3) Any hard latency SLAs (P95/P99) that must be met, or flexible targets.
4) Whether batching/fanned prompts are acceptable for the workflow.

Proposed 30–45 minute slots for the dedicated sizing & technical deep dive: 
- Tue Jun 22, 2027 — 17:00–17:30 UTC (10:00 PT)
- Wed Jun 23, 2027 — 21:00–21:30 UTC (14:00 PT)
- Thu Jun 24, 2027 — 16:00–16:30 UTC (09:00 PT)

If none of those work, tell me a couple of alternatives and I’ll send a calendar invite. I can also open a short shared Drive folder for traces (link below) if you want to drop the CSV/trace ahead of the call.

Calendar link (pick the slot that works): https://calendly.com/redwood/sizing-call
Drive folder: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1aB2cSizingInputs

I’ve CC’d Jordan (solutions engineering) and Markus (inference infra) — they’ll run the technical deep dive.

Thanks — looking forward to locking this in.

Best,
Monica Patel
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
monica.patel@redwood.ai | (415) 555-0182

Attachments referenced: dedicated-sizing-checklist.xlsx (short checklist we use to prep customers), redwood-dedicated-overview.pdf (brief)

From: Elena Ruiz <elena.ruiz@finova.com>

Hi Monica —

Appreciate the recap — that matches our internal notes. Quick answers to your outstanding items: 
1) I can pull a 48-hour sample trace from our staging proxy (timestamps + input/output token counts). I’ll upload it to the Drive folder by EOD today.
2) Sustained RPS: 18–25 requests/sec across our fleet today (staging). Production expected to be ~120–160 RPS sustained at GA. Bursts: 700–900 RPS for 2–4 minute spikes during peak onboarding flows.
3) Latency: P95 should be <= 250ms for interactive features. We can be a bit looser at P99 (up to ~400ms) for now, but that’s a hard escalation trigger for our infra team.
4) Batching: we prefer minimal added latency to the UI; small batching windows (50–100ms) are acceptable if it doesn't push us over the P95 target.

Thu Jun 24 at 16:00 UTC (09:00 PT) works for us — I’m looping in Paul (infra lead) who’ll join the call and can share the traces.

Thanks,
Elena Ruiz
Head of Product — Payments, Finova
elena.ruiz@finova.com | +1 646-555-0120

Thanks Elena — helpful numbers. A few quick technical clarifications ahead of the deep dive so we can prepare the right model/config combinations: 

- Can you confirm whether the token counts you gave include document context embeddings that we’d store in KV cache, or are they raw user prompt + response tokens? If you have a small sample trace, please label columns with input_tokens, context_tokens, output_tokens.
- Are the bursts evenly spread across many users (fan-out) or concentrated to a small set of heavy users? That changes batch sizing and cache hit assumptions.
- Do you plan to use streaming output in the UI or single-response (non-streamed)? Streaming has different latency/throughput trade-offs.
- Any data residency constraints we should know about (US-only region preferred?).

If you can drop the 48-hour trace in the Drive link Monica shared, Jordan and I will pre-compute an initial throughput/lower-bound capacity estimate and surface a couple of concrete Dedicated pool configurations (GPU types + qps per card) during the meeting.

—Markus
Markus Klein
Head of Inference Infrastructure, Redwood Inference
markus.klein@redwood.ai
